lines.text: Test day. How did you do?
Do really well on a test.
I aced my history test today!

data.mean: Do really well on a test.
data.define: To get a top result on a test or task.

example.text: I aced my history test today!

misuse.text: Don't say you 'aced' a test you failed.

data.l1_hook: परीक्षा का दिन। तुमने कैसे 'ace' किया?
data.l1_ex: मैंने आज अपना इतिहास टेस्ट ace किया!

native.tip: “ace” = बहुत बढ़िया प्रदर्शन करना. उदाहरण: “I aced my history test today!”
